Lean.Name.toString.fullDefinition: protected def toString (n : Name) (escape := true) : String :=   -- never escape "prettified" inaccessible names or macro scopes or pseudo-syntax introduced by the delaborator   toStringWithSep "." (escape && !n.isInaccessibleUserName && !n.hasMacroScopes && !maybePseudoSyntax) n where   maybePseudoSyntax :=     if let .str _ s := n.getRoot then       -- could be pseudo-syntax for loose bvar or universe mvar, output as is       "#".isPrefixOf s || "?".isPrefixOf s     else       false
Lean.Name.toString.description: This function converts an identifier into its string representation, with an option to escape special characters.

Lean.mkIdent.fullDefinition: def mkIdent (val : Name) : Ident :=   ⟨Syntax.ident SourceInfo.none (toString val).toSubstring val []⟩
Lean.mkIdent.description: This function creates an identifier from a name.

Lean.Syntax.isStrLit?.comment:
If the provided `Syntax` is a string literal, returns the string it represents.

Even if the `Syntax` is a `str` node, the function may return `none` if its internally ill-formed.
The parser should always create well-formed `str` nodes.
Lean.Syntax.isStrLit?.fullDefinition: def isStrLit? (stx : Syntax) : Option String :=   match isLit? strLitKind stx with   | some val => decodeStrLit val   | _        => none
Lean.Syntax.isStrLit?.description: This function determines whether a syntax element is a string literal and returns the corresponding string if it is valid.
